notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only. robots.txt was already checked by the prior Home-Decor pass for this SR (archive c234): 3 User-agent blocks (Spinn3r, AdsBot-Google-Mobile, *), no ClaudeBot/GPTBot/anthropic-ai entry and no Claude-specific Disallow -- not a policy block. Locale note: this browser's egress geoip resolves to India, so every page rendered as 'Etsy India' with INR pricing and a /in-en/ URL prefix on internal links; I tried overriding via Account > Locale Preferences (selected United States, saved) and via the on-page 'Deliver to' country filter (also set to United States), but the display locale did not change. This does not affect correctness: Etsy's category taxonomy (Home & Living > Furniture > ...) and each category's total-listing count are a single global catalog figure independent of viewer locale/currency -- only language and currency displayed differ, not which products match a category or how many. All recorded links use the canonical no-country-prefix form (https://www.etsy.com/c/...), which is what a US visitor sees. Category tree obtained by walking the Furniture department's mega-menu/breadcrumb from https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living/furniture down through each of its 6 room-based branches (Living Room, Entryway, Bedroom, Dining, Office, Kids), plus the Outdoor & Garden department's Patio Furniture branch (outdoor furniture is explicitly in scope per brief even though it sits outside the Furniture department nav). Each parent page's full child-category set was read directly from the DOM (category chip/tile links), not estimated. Furniture and Floor & Rugs, Bedding, Curtains, Storage & Organization, and the rest of Outdoor & Garden (gardening tools, fire pits, grills, planters, seeds) were not traversed -- out of scope for this project or covered by a separate Storage task. Search-query-string URLs (/search?q=) were never used or recorded as categories; only canonical /c/ category browse pages are recorded, per Section 3. QTY METHOD: every leaf's qty comes from the page's own schema.org ItemList JSON-LD 'numberOfItems' field (structured data). Etsy category pages render no visible 'N results' text in the normal DOM for most nodes, EXCEPT some pages (e.g. Kids' Benches & Toy Boxes) which do render a plain-text header 'N results, with ads' -- where both were present they matched exactly (494 = 494), which serves as this run's required corroboration that the JSON-LD figure is the true per-category count and not a site-wide or padded number (also confirmed non-constant: figures ranged 78 to 31,933 and varied node-to-node, ruling out a fixed default). EXCLUDED as non-furniture despite being filed under a Furniture/Outdoor department: living-room-furniture/slipcovers and /floor-pillows (textiles); entryway-furniture/umbrella-stands (small decorative holder, not seating/table/storage furniture); dining-room-furniture/dining-sets (node's actual products are dinnerware/place-setting sets and table linens, not table-and-chair furniture sets -- PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE contradicts the site's own label); office-furniture/laptop-trays-and-stands (small portable accessory, not furniture); kids-furniture/dressers-and-drawers (node's actual products are dresser hardware -- knobs, pulls, handles -- furniture parts/hardware, explicitly excluded by brief); outdoor-and-garden/patio-furniture/patio-umbrellas (shade accessory, not furniture); outdoor-and-garden/hammocks-and-swings (mixed rollup: about half the sampled titles were pure camping/hiking gear -- suspension straps, camping hammocks, hiking gear slings -- not furniture; dropped as a mixed rollup rather than force-included). FLAGGED and kept: entryway-furniture/shoe-storage -- dominant sample is furniture-type freestanding shoe racks/cabinets, but a stackable-plastic-storage-box listing also appeared; kept per the site's own Furniture-department classification with a manual-review flag. CROSS-LISTING NOTE: living-room-furniture/bookshelves and office-furniture/bookshelves are the identical underlying catalog node reachable via two different parent breadcrumbs (identical numberOfItems=2837 and identical sample product titles on both URLs). Both are emitted as separate rows per this project's established precedent for such site-side taxonomy overlaps (not deduplicated -- their links differ even though the content is the same set), and this is called out here rather than silently double-counted without disclosure. Sanity checks applied: h1 on every leaf page matched the category clicked through to; no qty was a suspiciously round number (no 1000/5000/10000 caps); qty varied meaningfully node to node (78 to 31,933) ruling out a constant/site-wide figure; canonical URLs (no query strings) were used throughout.
